name: fireball-vs-rhoa
description: Fireball against one spawned Rhoa at a fixed level: spawn, cast, collect the damage ledger, check the hit and the clamp. The smallest useful damage experiment.

steps.note: the id and the full label (<variety Name>@<level>) come back from /mobs
let the monster's emerge finish before it can be hit
by label; the Gateway resolves it to the spawned id
the projectile has to travel and land
the label is <variety Name>@<level>, not the name given to /spawn_mob: variety Rhoa is 'Rhoa Mare'. /cast matched 'Rhoa' by substring; the ledger records the full label.
